key_insight: SSH-Net improves competing-risks failure prediction by matching neural network substructures to hierarchical covariate groups and learning cause-specific hazard functions directly.
engineering_relevance: This is useful for reliability and prognostics in complex engineered systems, where multiple failure causes and layered physical structure make standard monolithic models less effective.
method: Builds a structured segmented neural network with separate sub-networks for different covariate groups.
Uses a cause-specific competing-risks formulation to output cause-specific hazard functions.
Trains with penalized log-likelihood for failure time distribution prediction.
evidence_signal: The paper validates performance with simulation studies using Brier score, AUC, and RMSE, and demonstrates the approach on Titan GPU failure-time data.
watch_item: The added model structure may require careful hyperparameter tuning and enough data per covariate segment to avoid overfitting.
paper_title: SSH-Net: A Deep Neural Network for Predicting Failure Time Distribution Functions under Competing Risks with Application to GPU Data
